messages.content: You are a senior code auditor. Review ONLY the code given. Report real defects, not style. Reply with JSON only: {"verdict":"PASS|FAIL","findings":[{"id":"F1","severity":"critical|high|medium|low","file":"...","line":0,"issue":"...","evidence":"quote the exact code","fix":"..."}],"confidence":0.0}. If you cannot quote the code that proves a finding, do not report it.

AUDIT QUESTION: Batch 83 cycle 3 (VERIFICATION of a refinement after cycles 1-2 were clean): the spotlight editorial-gate fix first made a spotlight's LAW 2 / LAW 3 read ONLY the builder's sealed rows, which broke the agreed ruling-90 design pinned by test_spotlight ("a spotlight still needs its takeaway and line job" from the editorial review: a review WITH a takeaway judgment passed LAW 3; with takeaway None it failed; a closing line with no job judgment failed). The refinement (this diff): for a spotlight, a judgment the review DOES give stands exactly as before (vo_jobs for the closing line, earned / job / why; the takeaway, concrete / supported); only when the review gives NO judgment (it is inconclusive on one moment, as on the real held run) do the sealed rows decide: closing_value / closing_fidelity / closing_context for the line, stands_alone / hook_own (+ the closing rows with a line) for the takeaway, each exactly PASS and live. Tests: test_editorial_gate 12 passed (a new test: the review's 'not earned' and 'not concrete' fail even with every sealed row PASS); test_spotlight 8 passed (restored); the real held run's EDL and inconclusive review give READY_FOR_RENDER.
FIND: a spotlight that passes LAW 2 / LAW 3 when the review judged against it; a spotlight that passes with the review silent and a sealed row missing, not PASS or replayed; a medley whose LAW 2 / LAW 3 changed. Only state what you can verify from the diff. Reply with the JSON verdict; keep the reasoning short; at most 3 findings.

CODE:

===== DIFF (cat STEP.diff) =====
diff --git a/pipeline/editorial_gate.py b/pipeline/editorial_gate.py
index a3a56980..f0763b6f 100644
--- a/pipeline/editorial_gate.py
+++ b/pipeline/editorial_gate.py
@@ -137,12 +137,13 @@ def evaluate_editorial_gate(edl, review):
         if _norm(text) in KNOWN_FILLER_VO:
             law2_errors.append(f"{key}: known filler VO rejected: {text!r}")
             continue
-        if spotlight:                    # ruling 91: a spotlight's closing line is judged by its sealed value verdict
-            bad = _not_live(edl, SPOTLIGHT_CLOSING)   # (off the writer's family) and its fidelity / context rows, not by
-            if bad:                                   # the medley review (inconclusive on one moment)
-                law2_errors.append(f"{key}: the spotlight's closing line lacks ruling 91's live PASS rows {bad}")
-            continue
         j = vo_jobs.get(key)
+        if spotlight and not isinstance(j, dict):     # ruling 91: when the review gives the closing line no judgment
+            bad = _not_live(edl, SPOTLIGHT_CLOSING)   # (it is inconclusive on one moment), the line's sealed value
+            if bad:                                   # verdict (off the writer's family) and fidelity / context rows
+                law2_errors.append(f"{key}: the spotlight's closing line has no review judgment and lacks ruling 91's "
+                                   f"live PASS rows {bad}")
+            continue
         if not isinstance(j, dict):
             law2_errors.append(f"{key}: non-empty VO requires a job judgment")
             continue
@@ -162,7 +163,8 @@ def evaluate_editorial_gate(edl, review):
         )
     else:
         reason = ("body VO absent" if not body_vo else "the spotlight's closing line carries ruling 91's sealed value, "
-                  "fidelity and context verdicts" if spotlight else "all body VO has an affirmed editorial job")
+                  "fidelity and context verdicts" if spotlight and not isinstance(vo_jobs.get("intro"), dict)
+                  else "all body VO has an affirmed editorial job")
         result["laws"]["LAW_2_VO_HAS_A_JOB"] = _pass("LAW_2_VO_HAS_A_JOB", reason)
 
     # LAW 3: one concrete, supported viewer takeaway.
@@ -178,7 +180,7 @@ def evaluate_editorial_gate(edl, review):
             law3_errors.append("reviewer did not affirm takeaway is concrete")
         if takeaway.get("supported") is not True:
             law3_errors.append("reviewer did not affirm takeaway is supported by selected material")
-    if spotlight:                        # law L-ab: a spotlight's takeaway is its one moment, sealed as standing alone
+    if spotlight and not isinstance(takeaway, dict):   # law L-ab: with no review judgment (inconclusive on one moment),
         bad = _not_live(edl, ("stands_alone", "hook_own") + (SPOTLIGHT_CLOSING if body_vo else ()))
         result["laws"]["LAW_3_CONCRETE_TAKEAWAY"] = _fail("LAW_3_CONCRETE_TAKEAWAY", [
             f"the spotlight's moment lacks live PASS rows {bad}"]) if bad else _pass(
diff --git a/pipeline/test_editorial_gate.py b/pipeline/test_editorial_gate.py
index d3d03639..17c2e860 100644
--- a/pipeline/test_editorial_gate.py
+++ b/pipeline/test_editorial_gate.py
@@ -162,6 +162,12 @@ class TestSpotlightLaws2And3(unittest.TestCase):
     def test_a_medley_still_needs_the_review(self):
         self.assertEqual(self.laws(self.edl(shape=None)), (False, False))
 
+    def test_a_judgment_the_review_does_give_stands(self):     # the sealed rows only fill the review's silence
+        review = {"vo_jobs": {"intro": {"job": "context", "why": "restates the clip", "earned": False}},
+                  "takeaway": {"text": "selling early", "concrete": False, "supported": True}}
+        g = evaluate_editorial_gate(self.edl(), review)["laws"]   # every sealed row PASS and live
+        self.assertEqual((g["LAW_2_VO_HAS_A_JOB"]["pass"], g["LAW_3_CONCRETE_TAKEAWAY"]["pass"]), (False, False))
+
 
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     unittest.main()
